basic_details.job_title: Civil Court Gumla Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for Peon/ Orderly Posts
basic_details.short_information: Civil Court Gumla has announced 17 vacancies for the Peon / Orderly post under advertisement number 01/2026. Eligible candidates must submit their offline application by post or by hand to the Principal District and Sessions Judge, Civil Court, Gumla on or before 20 November 2026. Applicants for the Peon / Orderly post require a 10th (Matric) pass or equivalent qualification, and the notified pay scale is Rs. 18,000-56,900/- (Level-1). The selection process for these posts consists of a Screening Test followed by an Interview.

qualification.details: Educational Qualification: Candidates must have passed the 10th (Matric) examination or equivalent from a recognized board. | Age Limit: Candidates must be at least 18 years old as of 15.10.2026. The maximum age limit is 35 years for General (Unreserved) candidates, 38 years for women, and 40 years for Scheduled Caste (SC) and Scheduled Tribe (ST) candidates (male/female). Age limits and reservation benefits are applicable as per Jharkhand State rules, and service conditions are governed by the Civil Court Rules. | Other Eligibility Conditions: Candidates must be citizens of India, mentally and physically healthy, possess good moral character, and not be involved in any criminal cases or convicted. Married candidates must not have more than one living spouse. Reservations and horizontal reservations for women, persons with disabilities (PwBD), and sports quotas apply as per government rules with valid certificates issued by competent authorities.

selection_process: The selection process for the Peon / Orderly posts consists of a Screening Test (स्क्रीनिंग टेस्ट) followed by an Interview (साक्षात्कार).

content_sections.heading: Civil Court Gumla Recruitment 2026 at a Glance

rows.details: 20.11.2026 up to 05:00 PM (from 10:30 AM on working days)

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Candidates must send their self-written application form and admit card in Devanagari script addressed to the Principal District and Sessions Judge, Civil Court, Gumla, PIN - 835207. Applications can be submitted personally by hand or sent through registered post or speed post during working days between 10:30 AM and 05:00 PM.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Educational Qualification: Candidates must have passed the 10th (Matric) examination or equivalent from a recognized board. Age Limit: Candidates must be at least 18 years old as of 15.10.2026. The maximum age limit is 35 years for General (Unreserved) candidates, 38 years for women, and 40 years for Scheduled Caste (SC) and Scheduled Tribe (ST) candidates (male/female). Age limits and reservation benefits are applicable as per Jharkhand State rules, and service conditions are governed by the Civil Court Rules. Other Eligibility Conditions: Candidates must be citizens of India, mentally and physically healthy, possess good moral character, and not be involved in any criminal cases or convicted. Married candidates must not have more than one living spouse. Reservations and horizontal reservations for women, persons with disabilities (PwBD), and sports quotas apply as per government rules with valid certificates issued by competent authorities.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Self-attested copies of certificates related to age, educational qualifications, and required eligibility. Self-attested copies of caste certificates issued by competent authorities for reserved category applicants. No Objection Certificate (if currently working in any government institution or corporation). Three recent passport-size photographs. Self-addressed envelope (25 cm x 11 cm) with Rs. 56/- postal stamp affixed.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process for the Peon / Orderly posts consists of a Screening Test (स्क्रीनिंग टेस्ट) followed by an Interview (साक्षात्कार).

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to submit the application for Civil Court Gumla Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit offline applications is 20 November 2026 up to 05:00 PM.

faq.question: Q2. What is the age relaxation applicable for reserved categories?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 35 years for General candidates, 38 years for women, and 40 years for SC/ST candidates (male and female) as of 15.10.2026, in accordance with Jharkhand State rules.

faq.question: Q3. How should the application form be filled and submitted?
faq.answer: Format 'Ka' of the application must be filled in Hindi in the candidate's own handwriting and signed, while format 'Kha' should also be attached in self-written format. Submissions must be sent by registered post, speed post, or delivered by hand to the Principal District and Sessions Judge, Civil Court, Gumla.

faq.question: Q4. What documents and enclosures must accompany the application?
faq.answer: Applicants must attach self-attested copies of certificates for age, education, and caste/category (if claiming reservation), three recent passport-size photographs, and a self-addressed stamped envelope (25 cm x 11 cm) with a Rs. 56/- postal stamp.
